name: regression-no-report
about: A regression run that produces no report (docs/decisions/2026-10-18-regression-trigger.md): the demo repo's scripts/e2e exits 2 before writing report.json (its sandbox did not come up). The runner reports why, with the last lines of its output, and #loop gets one message saying the run could not run; nothing to file. The next ask queues a new run; a mobile one waits for a runner with the emulator (this one offers none).
